map_info.name: LSystems_Living
map_info.description:
The world starts to grow. Grammar is no longer a demonstration — it is the terrain. Platforms rise at organic heights, clearings open where no rule reached, and the structure itself follows branching logic. After this, the ecosystem flags unlock: branching, flowers, trees. Your catalyst plants seeds.

[Placement applied humanoid_walker engine — constraint 0.941→0.960, walkability 0.588→0.701]

learning_objectives: Ecosystem emergence from local growth rules
Branching catalyst mode: planting and growing

documentation.summary: LSystems_Living — The finale. Grammar becomes biology.
documentation.layout: 10x10 organic terrain. Irregular heights, forest clearings as voids. The structure IS the L-system.
documentation.objective: Experience the transition from 'rules that make trees' to 'rules that make worlds'. This map unlocks ecosystem growth flags.
key_elements: Organic structure: platforms at varied heights following branching logic
Forest clearings as void spaces — where no rule reached
`genetic_tree_sculptor` at (4,4) — design your tree's DNA, press Plant to arm the catalyst
`lsystem_tree` at (5,2) — a grown tree, proof that grammar produces life
`branching_coral` at (2,6) — life in a different medium
Warm `recursive_world` ambient — the ecosystem is waking up
